scope: completed archived-observation visualization and fixed-model arithmetic counterfactual
original_study: dr_newday_weighted/run_v2; 5 conditions; 3 networks; fixed history models
distance: mean(abs((R1-R2)P+(X1-X2)Q)) over all nodes and 96 slots
objective: largest gain attained in at least 90 percent of scenarios
evaluation_order_statistic: 900th largest gain; scenarios reused pairwise from original working-law holdout
price_search: none; sites and relative prices frozen; common amplitude capped by resource and declared budget
duration_construction: historical gradient orders slots; full-day template; no future-based timing selection
amplitude_budget_rule: unchanged temporal template; alpha above 1 needs original budget times alpha squared
response_model: A=lambda*c*(1+D*z), lambda=.5, z iid Uniform[-1,1]^2 held whole day
response_status: synthetic continuous correlated response; not empirically calibrated whole-day behavior
independent_denominator_warning: 12 repeated settings of the same unresolved original case-day are not 12 independent failures
target_warning: original gamma is an increment target, not a topology rejection distance
interpretation: long-duration model effects require fresh frozen-policy physical and behavioral validation
